title: GACC-Bench: Benchmarking Goal-Adaptive Context Compression Ability across Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.21893v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Context compression in long-running applications of large language models (LLMs) must preserve goal-relevant information, often before specific downstream questions are known. We introduce GACC-Bench, a benchmark for Goal-Adaptive Context Compression that evaluates how reliably LLMs adapt information retention to specified high-level goals. For each source context, we derive one or more high-level goals by grouping source-grounded questions according to shared downstream objectives. The benchmark contains 500 goals and 2,571 questions over 281 document and agent-trace contexts from seven collections spanning diverse domains, with all instances reviewed by human experts. The compressor receives a source context, a goal, and a context-length budget, with the associated evaluation questions withheld. translated_title: GACC-Bench：跨大语言模型的目标自适应上下文压缩能力基准测试
translated_abstract: 在大语言模型（LLM）的长时间运行应用中，上下文压缩必须保留与目标相关的信息，而这往往发生在具体下游问题已知之前。我们提出了GACC-Bench，一个用于目标自适应上下文压缩的基准，用于评估大语言模型根据指定高级目标可靠地调整信息保留策略的能力。对于每个源上下文，我们通过根据共享的下游目标对基于源文本的问题进行分组，推导出一个或多个高级目标。该基准包含500个目标和2,571个问题，涵盖来自七个集合、跨越多个领域的281个文档和智能体轨迹上下文，所有实例均经过人类专家审核。压缩器接收源上下文、目标和上下文长度预算，而相关的评估问题则被隐藏。固定的阅读器使用相同的压缩上下文逐一回答这些问题。我们对十个LLM压缩器的评估揭示了实质性……
tldr: 该论文提出GACC-Bench基准，通过隐藏下游问题并仅给定高级目标与长度预算，评估大语言模型能否在未知具体问题的情况下可靠地进行目标自适应的上下文压缩。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces GACC-Bench, a benchmark that evaluates how reliably LLMs perform goal-adaptive context compression—retaining goal-relevant information under length budgets even when downstream questions are withheld.
